D. READING COMPREHENSION

I. Choose the best sentence describing the situation

II. Read the passage and choose the best option (27-31)

People celebrate the New Year in different ways. In Scotland, people believe that the first person who enters a house after midnight on New Year's Eve will decide the family's luck for the whole year. This custom is called "first-footing". They prefer a dark-haired man as their (27) ________. In Thailand, people throw water over each other in the street to (28) ________ away bad luck and bring good luck. In Japan, temples ring their bells (29) ________ times at midnight to clear out all the bad things. In Viet Nam, people usually throw some old things (30) ________ and clean their houses before Tet. They also buy salt for happiness and dress (31) ________ to visit their relatives.

III. Read the diary entry and do the tasks

Dear Diary,

Today, my mother and I went shopping for Tet. At the market, we saw many beautiful things. First, my mother asked: "Shall we buy a branch of peach blossoms?" and I agreed immediately because it looks so bright and beautiful. Then, we talked about banh chung. My mother asked: "How many banh chung shall we buy?" and we decided to buy four. We also bought some chocolate biscuits for Dad. My grandfather told us that we should behave well and shouldn't break anything at Tet because breaking things brings bad luck. In the evening, my father started to cook banh chung on an open fire. I love Tet so much!

Task 1: Decide True (T) or False (F)

MINI REVIEW - ÔN TẬP TỔNG HỢP UNIT 6

Tóm tắt các điểm quan trọng nhất trong bài học vừa rồi.

1. Key Vocabulary (Từ vựng trọng tâm)

  • • behave well: cư xử tốt, ngoan ngoãn
  • • branch of peach blossoms: cành hoa đào
  • • break things: làm vỡ đồ đạc (mang lại xui xẻo)
  • • cook banh chung on an open fire: nấu bánh chưng trên bếp lửa

2. Grammar Rules (Ngữ pháp quan trọng)

  • • Modal Verbs (Should / Shouldn't):
    S + should / shouldn't + V (nguyên thể). Dùng để khuyên nên/không nên làm gì.
  • • Making Suggestions (Shall we...?):
    Shall we + V (nguyên thể)? = Let's + V (nguyên thể).
  • • How many + N (đếm được số nhiều):
    Ví dụ: How many banh chung shall we buy?
